Looking at the problem description and the code, I need to fix missing `AttributeValueTranslation.name` for RichText and PlainText attributes. The issue is that when creating/updating translations for attribute values with rich text or plain text types, the `name` field should be automatically populated based on the translated content.

Let me examine the `AttributeValueTranslate` mutation and see how to propagate names for rich text and plain text attributes.

The fix needs to be implemented in the `AttributeValueTranslate` class to automatically set the `name` field when `rich_text` or `plain_text` is provided but `name` is not explicitly set.

```python
FILE: saleor/graphql/translations/mutations.py
<<<<<<< SEARCH
class AttributeValueTranslate(BaseTranslateMutation):
    class Arguments:
        id = graphene.ID(
            required=True,
            description="AttributeValue ID or AttributeValueTranslatableContent ID.",
        )
        language_code = graphene.Argument(
            LanguageCodeEnum, required=True, description="Translation language code."
        )
        input = AttributeValueTranslationInput(required=True)

    class Meta:
        description = "Creates/updates translations for an attribute value."
        model = attribute_models.AttributeValue
        object_type = AttributeValue
        error_type_class = TranslationError

    class Meta:
        description = "Creates/updates translations for an attribute value."
        model = attribute_models.AttributeValue
        object_type = AttributeValue
        error_type_class = TranslationError
        error_type_field = "translation_errors"
        permissions = (SitePermissions.MANAGE_TRANSLATIONS,)

    @classmethod
    def validate_input(cls, input_data):
        super().validate_input(input_data)
        
        # If name is not provided but rich_text or plain_text is provided,
        # propagate the rich_text/plain_text value to name field
        if not input_data.get("name"):
            if input_data.get("rich_text"):
                input_data["name"] = input_data["rich_text"]
            elif input_data.get("plain_text"):
```
